headline: Colombia to Retain VIS Social Housing Relief Under Fiscal Law
summary: Colombia's Ministry of Housing confirmed that VIS social housing benefits will be preserved under the 105-article Fiscal Rescue Law, which cuts spending and eliminates the 5% VAT rate.
why: Fiscal adjustments and housing subsidies shape Colombian government spending, construction sector revenues, and tax receipts.

impacts.name: Colombian Construction Sector
impacts.why: VIS benefits will remain intact despite broader government fiscal spending cuts.
